queries_run: onsemi distribution channel shift 2026 distributors inventory

findings.claim: 經銷商銷售占營收比重 2023–2025 為 52%→53%→54%，小幅上升；單一經銷商占 2025 營收約 11%（2024 約 10%）；經銷商透過退貨與庫存輪調條款轉售給 OEM／EMS。未見訂閱化／D2C／平台化轉型的一手紀錄。
findings.excerpt: Sales to distributors accounted for approximately 54%, 53% and 52% of our revenue in 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively. We had one distributor whose revenue accounted for approximately 11% and 10% of the total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 僅下 1 次搜尋，未找到 2026 通路結構性轉變（訂閱／D2C／平台）之來源；搜尋結果多為舊文或低品質部落格。
